parameters.query: SELECT area, median_price, avg_dom, months_of_supply, active_listings, list_to_sale_ratio FROM re.market_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC, area LIMIT 10
